BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1428.name: The Heaven'sDeity Glorious-Solute
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1428.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return every opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit to the Hand. For each Spirit returned to Hand by this effect, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.

[LV2][LV3] [Holy Life] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

PB13-05.name: Ground of Lolo
PB13-05.effect:
This Nexus card can't be deployed unless six costs is paid.

[LV1] (Your End Step)
If you control Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue Spirits, one of each, both players return all their cards to their decks and shuffle, and send all cores other than those in Life to the Void. Then, both players put six cores from the Void to their Reserve, draw two cards, play rock-paper-scissor to determine the playing order, and the game restarts from Turn 1. This effect can only be used by either you or the opponent once per game.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7809.name: Shieldybug
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7809.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Brave card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Brave must also be from the Reserve.

[When Braved] (When Battles)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8040.name: Sunk-Shine
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8040.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Spirit card. Then, during this turn, all your Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This exhausted Spirit can block opposing Spirits with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

PB13-03.name: The AngeliaEgg Hocha
PB13-03.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Refresh every Yellow Spirit you control. Then, summon this Spirit card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, by exhausting a "Divine Spirit" family Spirit you control, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.

PB13-04.name: The StarMedium Kushina
PB13-04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By destroying this Spirit, summon a [The SupernovaDragon Siegwurm-Nova] from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is also treated as a Red Spirit.
